description: Ideas captured from Boss that are not yet in the backlog. Every idea gets tracked here first, then promoted to a story when prioritized.

ideas.author: Boss
ideas.title: Biz Ops MongoDB Cluster
ideas.description: Break out a dedicated MongoDB cluster for business operations (lifecycle reservations, audit trails, build counters, promotion logs). Currently these are on the frontend cluster as an interim fix. The pipeline cluster is expensive and usually off — devops state should not be there. The frontend cluster is for user-facing data — devops state should not be there either.

ideas.author: Boss
ideas.title: Unattended Agent Space on HuggingFace
ideas.description: Dedicated HuggingFace Space for unattended agent work. Runs 24/7, monitors pipelines, grooms unrealized_ideas.json, executes overnight assignments, checks semaphores. Separate from the product app — no dev pollution. Secure access via HF token. Can expose a port for webhook callbacks.

ideas.author: Boss
ideas.title: Daily Agent Grooming of Unrealized Ideas
ideas.description: An agent reads unrealized_ideas.json daily, cross-references with architecture and backlog, proposes solutions and roadmap placement, surfaces recommendations for morning Boss review. The Brain grooms itself.

ideas.author: Boss
ideas.title: Continuous Improvement Opportunity
ideas.description: These are real KPIs that must be broken down to measurable things and Skip must set goals for improvement and work to meet them.

kpis: Time from policy creation to enforcement in code
Docs updated in same commit as design change
Component diagram accuracy vs actual code
Percentage of code changes linked to a story
Percentage of stories with boolean testable requirements
Orphan code (code with no backlog item)
Time from idea to deployed code
Time from bug report to fix deployed
Playwright tests written vs features shipped
Pydantic model coverage on tool inputs
SIT test coverage vs total features
Percentage of features with passing SIT before deploy
Time between code change and test execution
Mean time to recover from pipeline failure
State filter enforcement (records processed vs expected)
Features rebuilt due to wrong interpretation
Clarifying questions asked before coding vs after
Components placed in wrong location count
Ad hoc decisions without backlog item
Design decisions made without asking Boss
Times Boss had to correct same mistake twice
Jobs monitored to completion without intervention

recommended_roadmap.epic: Continuous — not an epic, a practice
